action.rationale: Fresh 10D problem with only 100 evaluations (< 20·dim = 200). I’ll run light probes P1–P3 within 12 evals (~12% of budget) to gauge global structure and smoothness before committing to a method on this cheap, deterministic landscape.

Budget left is 88 (< 30·dim = 300) and probes show global structure (P2 fdc_spearman = 0.5315) but widespread good points (top10_spread_vs_uniform = 0.8614), suggesting several basins with structure where CMA-ES is effective. Starting CMA-ES from the incumbent (y = 146.55) gives a robust global search before polishing.

CMA-ES has plateaued for 25 evaluations with no improvement (best stayed 107.17 from eval 39 to 62) and only 38 evaluations remain, so global exploration is unlikely to pay off. Probes indicate some global structure (P2 fdc 0.53), and with P5 unavailable a robust gradient-free local polish (BOBYQA) from the incumbent is the safest way to gain now.
